title: Feature: hex-native eBay clone MVP
description: Decompose the eBay-clone MVP into adapter-bounded steps with strict hex layering. Tier 0 establishes domain types and port traits with no dependencies. Tier 1 builds the marketplace STDB WASM module (its own bounded crate) and the backend's secondary adapters (stdb_client, image_store_fs, jwt_signer, password_hasher, clock). Tier 2 implements primary HTTP adapters (axum handlers). Tier 3 wires use cases (orchestrators). Tier 4 composes everything in a single composition_root.rs. Tier 5 builds the Solid.js frontend. Tier 6 adds integration + acceptance tests, the start.sh lifecycle script, README, and the hex analyze + smoke gate.

steps.description: Create the example project skeleton and backend crate manifest. Adds the backend Rust crate (binary + lib) and links docs/specs into the example. No business code yet; just Cargo metadata + module skeleton files so subsequent steps have a place to add code.
steps.done_condition: cargo check -p ebay-clone-backend succeeds with empty modules; .env.example documents DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, STDB_URI; docs/specs/ebay-mvp.json is symlinked or copied under examples/ebay-clone/docs/specs/

steps.description: Domain value types: newtypes for UserId (STDB Identity hex string), ListingId(u64), BidId(u64), AuctionId(u64), Money(u64 cents), Username (canonical lowercase, validation), ListingTitle (3-120 chars, trimmed, no control chars), ListingDescription (0-4096), Timestamp(i64 unix-millis UTC), DurationMs(i64). Each type owns its own validation in TryFrom impls. No external deps beyond serde.
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; unit tests cover Username/Title/Money validation including all rejection cases in specs 003, 007, 008; no f32/f64 anywhere; types are Serialize+Deserialize via serde

steps.description: Domain aggregates and enums: AuctionStatus (Active|Closed|Unsold), Listing struct, Auction struct (current_highest_cents, current_highest_bidder, end_time, status, winner_identity, winning_amount_cents), Bid struct, User struct (id, canonical username, created_at — no password hash; that lives in a port DTO), ImageRef (sha256 + content_type + byte_size), WatchEntry struct. Domain errors as a single DomainError enum.
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; AuctionStatus serializes round-trip; DomainError variants cover all reducer error codes (username_taken, invalid_username, invalid_title_length, invalid_starting_price, invalid_duration, bid_too_low, auction_ended, self_bid_forbidden); zero adapter imports

steps.description: Port trait definitions — pure async traits, depend ONLY on core::domain. UserRepoPort (CRUD against the user table via STDB), ListingRepoPort (read-only queries — listings are written by reducers), AuctionRepoPort (read-only), BidRepoPort (read-only), WatchRepoPort (read-only), ReducerCallPort (call WASM reducers: register_user, create_listing, place_bid, watch_listing), ImageStorePort (store/get by sha256), PasswordHasherPort (hash + verify, argon2id), TokenIssuerPort (issue + verify JWT), ClockPort (now_unix_millis). All traits Send+Sync+async. Use async-trait. Define DTOs (CreateListingInput etc.) here so adapters don't leak domain types they shouldn't see.
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; every port file imports only `crate::core::domain::*` (lint-grep checked); no port file mentions axum/reqwest/spacetimedb/argon2/jsonwebtoken/tokio_fs — keep them abstract

steps.description: Marketplace SpacetimeDB WASM module — Cargo manifest, lib.rs entrypoint, and the tables: User (Identity primary, canonical username unique), Listing (id, seller_identity, title, description, starting_price_cents, image_sha256s, created_at), Auction (listing_id PK, end_time, current_highest_cents, current_highest_bidder Option<Identity>, status string, winner_identity Option<Identity>, winning_amount_cents u64, closed_at i64), Bid (id, auction_id, bidder_identity, amount_cents, placed_at), Watchlist (user_identity, listing_id, added_at — composite key), CloseAuctionSchedule (scheduled table for close_auction). All tables `public` so STDB WebSocket subscribers receive updates.
steps.done_condition: `spacetime build` succeeds against the crate (or `cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown` if spacetime CLI absent); all six tables compile with public visibility; CloseAuctionSchedule has ScheduleAt + scheduled reducer hook stub

steps.description: Marketplace reducers (part 1): register_user and create_listing. register_user validates Username rules, hashes nothing (backend handles password hashing — module stores only canonical username + the user's Identity), inserts a User row with created_at = ctx.timestamp; rejects duplicates with 'username_taken'; rejects invalid names with 'invalid_username'. create_listing validates title length, starting_price_cents range (1..=100_000_000), duration_ms range (60_000..=2_592_000_000); inserts Listing + Auction rows atomically; schedules close_auction at end_time via the CloseAuctionSchedule table.
steps.done_condition: module compiles to WASM; reducer signatures match exactly: register_user(ctx, username: String, _password_unused: String), create_listing(ctx, title, description, starting_price_cents: u64, duration_ms: i64, image_sha256s: Vec<String>); all 7 spec failure modes return distinct error strings; no panics — every error path returns Err

steps.description: Marketplace reducers (part 2): place_bid, close_auction (scheduled), watch_listing. place_bid checks auction.status == Active, ctx.timestamp < auction.end_time (ebay-spec-014 race window), ctx.sender != listing.seller_identity (ebay-spec-015), amount_cents > current_highest_cents (ebay-spec-013); inserts Bid + updates Auction.current_highest_*. close_auction (scheduled) transitions status to Closed; if current_highest_bidder is Some, sets winner_identity + winning_amount_cents; if None, sets status to Closed with winner_identity=None + winning_amount_cents=0 (unsold derivable). watch_listing toggles a Watchlist row.
steps.done_condition: module compiles to WASM; close_auction is registered as a scheduled reducer triggered by the CloseAuctionSchedule table; place_bid rejects all 4 failure modes (012/013/014/015) with distinct error strings; idempotent re-fire of close_auction on an already-closed auction is a no-op (no double-close)

steps.description: Secondary adapter: STDB client wrapper. Implements UserRepoPort, ListingRepoPort, AuctionRepoPort, BidRepoPort, WatchRepoPort (read-only queries) AND ReducerCallPort (calls register_user / create_listing / place_bid / watch_listing). Single connection per backend process; subscribes to relevant tables; exposes table snapshots via the read-only ports; calls reducers via spacetimedb-sdk client API. NOT used by anything except composition-root.
steps.port: UserRepoPort + ListingRepoPort + AuctionRepoPort + BidRepoPort + WatchRepoPort + ReducerCallPort
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; every public type/function is reachable from the port-trait impls (no orphan code); module imports zero sibling adapters; spec 023 hex-analyze passes for this adapter directory

steps.description: Secondary adapter: filesystem image store. Implements ImageStorePort. store(bytes, content_type) -> sha256(bytes), writes to data/images/<sha256>.<ext> only if not already present (idempotent per ebay-spec-010), returns ImageRef. get(sha256) -> Option<(bytes, content_type)>. Enforces max 5 MiB and content_type whitelist (image/png, image/jpeg). Root directory configurable; defaults to examples/ebay-clone/backend/data/images/.
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; unit test verifies idempotent store (same bytes -> same path, no rewrite); oversize returns ImageStoreError::TooLarge (mapped to 413 upstream); wrong MIME returns ImageStoreError::UnsupportedMediaType (mapped to 415); imports only ports + domain + tokio fs

steps.description: Secondary adapter: argon2id password hasher (implements PasswordHasherPort with hash() and verify(), random per-user salt, OWASP-recommended parameters) + JWT signer (implements TokenIssuerPort with HS256, 24h TTL, claims include username + STDB identity hex). Both adapters live in one step because they share the auth slice and are both pure crypto wrappers with no other surface.
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; argon2 verify is constant-time; password buffer is zeroized after verify (via Zeroizing wrapper or explicit drop); JWT signing reads secret only from constructor argument (composition-root supplies env var); imports zero sibling adapters

steps.description: Secondary adapter: system clock. Implements ClockPort.now_unix_millis() via SystemTime::now(). Trivial but kept as an adapter so use cases can inject a TestClock in unit tests (ebay-spec-014 race window needs deterministic time control).
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; ClockPort impl returns i64 unix-millis UTC; no chrono required

steps.description: Primary adapter: axum HTTP scaffolding — Router builder, shared AppState struct (holds Arc<dyn Port> for each port the handlers need), error mapping module (DomainError -> StatusCode), JSON request/response DTOs, JWT extractor middleware that verifies via TokenIssuerPort. No business logic yet; just the wiring that subsequent handler steps will populate.
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; AppState holds only `Arc<dyn Port>` fields (no concrete adapter types); auth_middleware rejects missing/invalid Authorization header with 401; imports only ports + domain

steps.description: Primary adapter: auth HTTP handlers. POST /api/v1/auth/register (calls register-user use case), POST /api/v1/auth/login (calls login use case, returns { token, username, expires_at }). Routes are unauthenticated. Wires into the Router from step-12.
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; integration-test style test (in-crate) verifies that 200 OK is returned on valid login and 401 on bad password — using an in-memory fake of UserRepoPort + PasswordHasherPort

steps.description: Primary adapter: listings HTTP handlers. POST /api/v1/listings (auth required, calls create-listing use case which calls ReducerCallPort::create_listing), GET /api/v1/listings (search with q, active, max_price_cents, limit, offset — calls ListingRepoPort directly via a use case), GET /api/v1/listings/:id (single listing + its auction).
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; search handler honors all 4 query params (q, active, max_price_cents, limit/offset); pagination defaults limit=20 max=100; sort by end_time ASC

steps.description: Primary adapter: bidding + watchlist + won-items HTTP handlers. POST /api/v1/listings/:id/bid (auth required, calls place-bid use case), POST /api/v1/listings/:id/watch (auth required, toggles), GET /api/v1/me/bids (auth), GET /api/v1/me/won (auth, filters auctions where winner_identity == me), GET /api/v1/me/listings (auth, filters listings where seller_identity == me).
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; bid endpoint maps reducer 'bid_too_low' -> 409 Conflict, 'auction_ended' -> 410 Gone, 'self_bid_forbidden' -> 403 Forbidden; /me/* endpoints all require JWT

steps.description: Primary adapter: image upload HTTP handler. POST /api/v1/images multipart/form-data (auth required). Reads multipart stream, enforces 5 MiB cap before buffering, calls ImageStorePort via an upload-image use case, returns { sha256, content_type, byte_size }. Maps adapter errors: TooLarge -> 413, UnsupportedMediaType -> 415.
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; multipart limit is enforced via axum DefaultBodyLimit + per-field size check, so 6 MiB upload is rejected without buffering entire body; idempotent on duplicate sha256

steps.description: Use case: auth — register_user and login. register_user: validates Username + Password via domain rules, hashes password via PasswordHasherPort, calls ReducerCallPort::register_user, then UserRepoPort to fetch back the created row. login: looks up user by canonical username, verifies password via PasswordHasherPort, issues JWT via TokenIssuerPort, returns AuthResult { token, username, expires_at }.
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; unit tests with in-memory port fakes cover success + every error path; imports only domain + ports (zero adapter imports)

steps.description: Use case: listings — create_listing, search_listings, get_listing. create_listing validates title/price/duration via domain types, calls ReducerCallPort::create_listing with image sha256s, then ListingRepoPort to read back. search_listings filters by q (case-insensitive substring on title), active flag, max_price_cents, sorts by end_time ASC, paginates. get_listing returns Listing + Auction.
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; unit tests use in-memory fakes; search test verifies sort order + filter combinations + pagination boundaries

steps.description: Use case: bidding + watchlist + my-account. place_bid (calls ReducerCallPort::place_bid; reducer enforces all bid rules — use case maps reducer errors to DomainError). toggle_watch (ReducerCallPort::watch_listing). list_my_bids (BidRepoPort filtered by bidder_identity). list_my_won (AuctionRepoPort filtered by winner_identity + status=Closed). list_my_listings (ListingRepoPort filtered by seller_identity).
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; unit tests verify all 4 bid-rejection mappings and the listing-marked-sold derivation

steps.description: Use case: upload_image. Validates content_type whitelist, byte size, calls ImageStorePort::store. Pure thin wrapper but lives in usecases/ so the primary adapter never sees the secondary adapter type.
steps.done_condition: cargo check passes; unit test confirms idempotency on repeated calls with same bytes

steps.description: Composition root: main.rs + composition_root.rs. Reads env (DATABASE_URL/STDB_URI, JWT_SECRET, IMAGE_ROOT, BACKEND_ADDR), instantiates concrete adapters (StdbClient, FsImageStore, Argon2Hasher, JwtSigner, SystemClock), boxes each as `Arc<dyn Port>`, constructs AppState, builds the axum Router (from primary adapter step-12), spawns it on 0.0.0.0:8080. THIS IS THE ONLY FILE IN THE BACKEND THAT IS PERMITTED TO IMPORT FROM `crate::adapters::*` MODULES.
steps.done_condition: cargo build -p ebay-clone-backend succeeds; `hex analyze examples/ebay-clone/backend/` reports zero boundary violations; composition_root.rs is the only file matching `grep -r 'use crate::adapters' src/` excluding adapter mod.rs files; backend starts and serves /api/v1/health

steps.description: Frontend scaffold: Solid.js + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind. package.json (bun-friendly), vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, index.html, src/index.tsx, src/App.tsx with a placeholder route layout. No business UI yet.
steps.done_condition: `bun install && bun run build` (or `npm`) succeeds; Vite dev server starts on :5173; Tailwind classes apply (sanity check)

steps.description: Frontend API client + STDB WebSocket client. src/api/http.ts wraps fetch with the JWT header. src/api/stdb.ts opens a WebSocket to the STDB host and subscribes to listings, auctions, bids, watchlist tables. All u64 cents are kept as bigint or number (with care) — never floats. Types mirror domain (TypeScript interfaces).
steps.done_condition: money.ts has formatUSD(cents: bigint|number) -> string; never imports a float type; types include Listing, Auction, Bid, User; STDB client reconnects on close with exponential backoff capped at 30s

steps.description: Frontend auth pages: Register, Login. Stores JWT in memory + sessionStorage (NOT localStorage to keep cross-tab risk low). Adds a useAuth() store (Solid signal) used by the rest of the app.
steps.done_condition: register and login pages submit, store JWT, redirect to / on success; invalid login shows an inline error message; no token logged to console

steps.description: Frontend home + search page: lists active auctions with search box, max-price slider, sort by end_time ASC, pagination. Calls GET /api/v1/listings. Renders each card with cover image, title, current price, time remaining.
steps.done_condition: search box debounce 250ms; URL state syncs with query params; closed listings never appear when active=true

steps.description: Frontend listing-detail page with live bid feed (ebay-spec-020). Subscribes to STDB tables auction WHERE listing_id=:id and bid WHERE auction_id=:id. Renders countdown timer (ticks each 1s using end_time - now), current highest, bid history, place-bid form. New bids appear within 1s without manual refresh.
steps.done_condition: place-bid form disables when auction.status != Active or countdown hits 0; bid history prepends in <1s after STDB push; bid amount validation client-side mirrors reducer (>current_highest); error toast on 409/410/403

steps.description: Frontend post-listing page: form with title, description, starting price (input formatted as USD but stored as integer cents), duration picker (60s to 30d), up to 8 image uploads (POST /api/v1/images for each, collect sha256s, then POST /api/v1/listings).
steps.done_condition: client-side validation matches reducer rules; image upload progress shown per file; cap at 8 images enforced before submit

steps.description: Frontend my-account pages: MyBids (GET /api/v1/me/bids), MyWon (GET /api/v1/me/won), MyListings (GET /api/v1/me/listings — shows sold-to badge per ebay-spec-021).
steps.done_condition: all three pages require JWT (redirect to /login if missing); MyWon shows only auctions where winner_identity == current user and status == Closed

steps.description: Backend integration tests. Spins up a temporary STDB instance (or uses the spacetimedb in-memory test harness if available), publishes the marketplace module, runs the backend bound to an ephemeral port, exercises the full REST surface end-to-end. Cover the negative specs (013/014/015) via direct ReducerCallPort calls and assert the HTTP status codes from the primary adapter mapping.
steps.done_condition: `cargo test -p ebay-clone-backend --test 'integration_*'` is green; tests do not depend on a fixed port (ephemeral); test harness tears down STDB module on drop

steps.description: Acceptance test: end-to-end happy path (ebay-spec-021). A single test (Rust integration test driving headless browser via fantoccini/playwright OR a scripted REST+STDB sequence that mirrors the UI flow) that: registers user A and user B, A posts a listing, B places a bid, waits for auction close, asserts winner=B in MyWon and sold-to-B in MyListings. Duration shortened to ~10s for test runtime; production min is still 60s.
steps.done_condition: acceptance test passes; runtime under 60s; clearly asserts ALL six conditions of ebay-spec-021 with distinct assertion messages
evidence: cd examples/ebay-clone/backend && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --test acceptance_happy_path -q

steps.description: start.sh + README.md + docker-compose.yml (optional). start.sh launches STDB, publishes marketplace, starts backend (port 8080) and Vite (port 5173), prints all URLs, traps SIGINT to kill the three child PIDs and wait for clean reap within 5s; exits 0. README documents prereqs (rust, spacetime CLI, bun), env vars, and the acceptance walkthrough.
steps.done_condition: start.sh is executable (chmod +x); SIGINT cleanup verified via spec-022 smoke (no orphan processes, no stale port bindings within 5s); README has a one-liner ./start.sh and a Troubleshooting section

steps.description: Hex analyze + start.sh smoke acceptance gate. Runs `hex analyze examples/ebay-clone/backend` and asserts zero boundary violations; runs `./examples/ebay-clone/start.sh` in smoke mode (--smoke flag exits after health checks pass on all three services). This is the final acceptance gate — only this step blocks merge of feat/ebay-mvp/* to main.
steps.done_condition: `hex analyze examples/ebay-clone/backend` exits 0; `./examples/ebay-clone/start.sh --smoke` exits 0 within 60s and leaves no child processes

concurrency.notes: Tier-1 parallel set: step-5 (STDB module init), step-8 (stdb client), step-9 (image fs), step-10 (auth crypto), step-11 (clock). step-6 and step-7 are SERIALIZED behind step-5 (same crate, same lib.rs). Tier-2 steps 13/14/15/16 are parallel-safe (each handler file is disjoint) but each edits primary/http_axum/mod.rs — coordinate via a single integrator commit OR designate step-12 to leave router-registration stubs that handler steps fill in disjoint regions. Tier-3 use-case steps 17/18/19/20 are file-disjoint and fully parallel. Tier-5 frontend steps 24-28 each own disjoint page files; only App.tsx is shared (handle via small dedicated edits or a router-table file).

phase_gates.after_tier_1: cargo check --workspace && (cd examples/ebay-clone/spacetime-modules/marketplace && spacetime build || cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown)

open_questions_resolved.auth_coupling: Backend issues JWT (HS256) on /api/v1/auth/login. JWT claims include the user's STDB Identity hex. Frontend uses JWT for REST and presents the same Identity to STDB via spacetimedb-sdk client auth (STDB SDK derives Identity from a private key the backend issues at register-time; for MVP, the simplification is: backend signs reducer calls server-side so the frontend never needs a separate STDB credential — frontend talks to STDB read-only via WebSocket subscriptions; ALL mutations route through the backend). Documented in step-21 composition_root.rs.
open_questions_resolved.image_storage: Filesystem under examples/ebay-clone/backend/data/images/<sha256>.<ext> via ImageStorePort. S3-compatible alternative remains a port-level swap — no spec change needed (resolved: filesystem for MVP, port keeps the door open).
open_questions_resolved.auction_cancellation: OUT OF SCOPE for MVP. No cancel reducer. Confirmed.
open_questions_resolved.bid_retraction: OUT OF SCOPE. eBay-style: bids are binding.
open_questions_resolved.pagination_defaults: limit=20 default, max=100 (enforced in search-listings use case, step-18).
open_questions_resolved.time_source_authority: ctx.timestamp from the WASM reducer is canonical for all auction-related decisions. Backend ClockPort is used ONLY for JWT expiry and non-auction display; no auction-close logic ever reads backend clock.
open_questions_resolved.currency: USD only. No multi-currency. Display formatting USD-only in frontend (money.ts).

risk_register.risk: Highest. The STDB client adapter implements SIX ports in one crate. spacetimedb-sdk Rust client subscriptions are async + stream-based; mapping them to synchronous-feeling repo ports requires careful in-process state caching (probably an Arc<RwLock<TableSnapshot>> updated by background subscription tasks). If this is naively implemented as a fresh subscribe-per-query, latency will dominate the bid feed and ebay-spec-020 (<1s update) will regress.
risk_register.mitigation: Pre-build a single SubscriptionStore in step-8 that holds the latest snapshot of each table; repo ports read from the store. Background tokio task feeds the store. Property-test with a fake subscription stream.

risk_register.risk: Second-highest. Composition root depends on TWELVE other steps. If any port signature changes during the parallel build (steps 8-20), composition_root has to rebase across the wave. Mitigation: freeze port signatures at end of step-4 and treat them as a contract — adapter implementers may NOT extend port traits without an explicit handoff back to a planner edit of step-4.
Acceptance test runtime + flake risk. Auction close timing requires the test to wait for ctx.timestamp >= end_time; if the STDB scheduler is slow, the test will time out or race.
risk_register.mitigation: Acceptance harness must POLL on Auction.status == Closed (with a 30s budget) rather than sleep-then-assert; assert at the end on field values, not on transition timing.
